id.description: The unique identifier of the leg.

callId.description: The unique identifier of the parent call.

source.description: The source number or SIP URI.

destination.description: The destination number or SIP URI.

duration.description: The duration of the leg in seconds.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the leg was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the leg was last updated.

answeredAt.description: The date and time when the leg was answered.

endedAt.description: The date and time when the leg ended.
